assumptions: Finite simple core K_r plus one short independent leaf and two full-core independent leaves; the host order is r+3. All packing is edge-disjoint.
The theorem requires r=3^k with k>=2 and 2<=a<=r. All these sizes have a full saturated primal; the one-third dual is not merely assumed feasible.
Q means integral core variables and fractional alpha/beta; no equality with J, nu, L_D or J_fix is assumed.
The proof uses explicit F_3 arithmetic, finite edge counting, weak LP duality and integer congruences; no external design-existence theorem is imported.

atomic_claims.text: For every k>=2, r=3^k, p=1, q=2 and actual A with 2<=a<=r, explicit full primal/dual certificates prove L=(C(r,2)+a+2r)/3 and the exact mixed optimum is Q=C(r,2)/3+2r/3+floor(a/3)/2.

Writing b=a mod 3, the construction has S_core=(a-b)/2, S_short=b, S_long=0. An arbitrary-core parity and residual-edge-count congruence argument proves the matching lower bound S>=(a+b)/2, so L-Q=(a+b)/6.

A relabeled pair of affine parallel classes supplies the new support for every actual A. Conjugated nonlinear shear changes exactly r(r-3)/9 old integral core triangles at identical objective and slack, without a reopening budget.

Actual three final bounded runs all exit zero: all 114 cardinalities at r=9,27,81, all 502 actual nine-core subsets of size at least two, nine larger specified cases, four support exchanges, two rational quotient/residual LP implementations, twelve rejected mutations and nine valid boundary controls.

objective: Prove the entire fixed p=1,q=2 slice, core r=3^k and arbitrary actual short subset, with explicit optimal Q witnesses and a global parity-plus-residue bound. Preserve growing-budget uniform-face and both admitted stronger obligations as open.
risks: The entire fixed-budget slice is proved only at the candidate natural-language level. Growing p,q, the whole low-long-budget uniform face, general two-level gap, exact split domination and ProblemContract root remain open.
Finite degree dynamic programming is an integer relaxation, not full residual graph enumeration. No global Q optimizer was run; global optimality follows from the written bound and matching witness.
The two LP implementations and all runs share the generator trust domain. No registered trusted verifier, semantic review or closure receipt was generated.
Old quarter and twelfth points are different-parameter scope controls; their Q values are not inferred here. Zero/equal boundary fixtures do not imply an arbitrary-budget theorem.
Quadratic support change has zero change in value; it is not a claim that the common optimum has zero absolute defect.
